# Phaser runtime

`phaser.min.js` is the unmodified Phaser 4.2.1 browser distribution from the npm `phaser` package (`dist/phaser.min.js`). Its MIT license is in `PHASER-LICENSE.md`.

Keeping the runtime here preserves direct, offline opening of `index.html`. If updating Phaser, update the pinned npm version, this file, and the vendored distribution together, then run both test suites.
